trueatmosphere.configuration.displayExpo: Linear trim on the baked sky colour: 1.0 is the physical sky the bake produced.
trueatmosphere.configuration.moonGain.to: Brightness of the moonlight added to the night sky.
trueatmosphere.configuration.moonGlareKn: Soft shoulder on a bright moon, so a low moon does not paint a second sunset.
trueatmosphere.configuration.moonSaturat: How much colour the moonlight keeps; low values are the eye's Purkinje shift.
